t: 由佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博阿(Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa)所领导的海…
te: A naval expedition led by Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founds Nombre de Jesús, the first of two short-lived Spanish settle…
dz: 由佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博阿(Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa)所领导的海军远征队发现了诺姆布雷·德·耶苏斯(Normbre de Jesús),这是麦哲伦海峡上两个短暂的西班牙定居点中的第一个.
de: A naval expedition led by Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founds Nombre de Jesús, the first of two short-lived Spanish settlements in the Strait of Magellan.

t: 沃尔特·拉利爵士被授予了将弗吉尼亚殖民化的专利.
te: Sir Walter Raleigh is granted a patent to colonize Virginia.
dz: 沃尔特·拉利爵士被授予了将弗吉尼亚殖民化的专利.
de: Sir Walter Raleigh is granted a patent to colonize Virginia.

t: 圣地亚哥·德·维拉成为西班牙殖民地菲律宾的第六任总督.
te: Santiago de Vera becomes sixth governor-general of the Spanish colony of the Philippines.
dz: 圣地亚哥·德·维拉成为西班牙殖民地菲律宾的第六任总督.
de: Santiago de Vera becomes sixth governor-general of the Spanish colony of the Philippines.

t: 菲利普·阿马达斯和亚瑟·巴洛抵达了罗阿诺克岛.
te: Philip Amadas and Arthur Barlowe arrive at Roanoke Island.
dz: 菲利普·阿马达斯和亚瑟·巴洛抵达了罗阿诺克岛.
de: Philip Amadas and Arthur Barlowe arrive at Roanoke Island.

t: 马龙派学院成立于罗马.
te: The Maronite College is established in Rome.
dz: 马龙派学院成立于罗马.
de: The Maronite College is established in Rome.

t: 奥兰治的威廉一世被巴尔塔萨尔·盖拉德(英语:Balthasar Gérard)暗杀于他位于荷兰…
te: William I of Orange is assassinated in his home in Delft, Holland, by Balthasar Gérard.
dz: 奥兰治的威廉一世被巴尔塔萨尔·盖拉德(英语:Balthasar Gérard)暗杀于他位于荷兰德勒夫特的家中.
de: William I of Orange is assassinated in his home in Delft, Holland, by Balthasar Gérard.
